notes.title: Game Updates
notes.notes:
I’ve been reading your reviews and discussion posts.

I understand that for some players, the game might feel a bit too simple or like it’s missing something. I’m more than open to making updates—whether that means new features or fixes—as long as there are people interested in seeing this game grow.

If you have suggestions, ideas, or even complaints, please drop them here. I’d love to hear from anyone who wants to see changes or improvements.
